notes.title: Movavi Video Editor 2024: It Gets Even Better
notes.content:
[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2576030/Movavi_Video_Editor_2024/]Meet the new Video Editor 2024![/url][/b]

[b]Here are just some of the fresh features:[/b]

[b]- Revamped timeline. [/b]
The new timeline is now clearer and more streamlined. Get your projects done faster and have more fun with any types of videos.

[b]- Frame-precise cuts in a click. [/b]
Give your videos a sharper look with the new video-cutting tool. Easily make precise cuts and create eye-catching montages.

[b]- Perfect-match overlay effects. [/b]
Now each overlay effect has 13 blending modes to choose from. Try each of them  and pick the one that fits your video perfectly.

[b]- Pro-quality color correction. 
[/b]Get next-level color correction with the same simplicity. Boost colors in a snap and make more viewers fall in love with your videos.
[b]
- Our best effects – at your fingertips. [/b]
Create awesome videos in any style with our huge collection of professionally designed effects. 

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/36721/Upgrade_Movavi_Video_Editor_2023_to_Movavi_Video_Editor_2024/]Get the new 2024 version of Movavi Video Editor with an upgrade discount.
[/url][/b]

If you already [b]have effects packs for Movavi Video Editor 23[/b], you can [b]get the following sets for the new 24 version for free — they will be available in your Steam Library.[/b] 
These are:
[b]Cinematic set, My Channel Pack for YouTube, Timeless Pack, Rule Your Game Music Pack , Cyberpunk Overlay Pack, Digital Overlay Pack, Action Pack, Good Game Pack , Let's Play Pack.[/b]

notes.title: Meet the new Video Editor 2023!
notes.content:
[b]Level up with the new Movavi Video Editor! Splash your summer videos with creativity and let them explode into a feast of the senses![/b]
[h3]Highlights[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]Remove or change the background of your video in a single click. 
 [/b]Our brand-new AI Background Removal tool can recognize that there are people in the frame and neatly cut out the surroundings.
[*] [b]Another smart feature: AI Noise Removal. 
[/b]Make your audio crystal-clear with the help of artificial intelligence.
[*] [b]A new way to track objects using artificial intelligence. 
[/b]Link titles, stickers, or masks to objects in the video. Take your videos to a new level!
[*] [b]New music. 
[/b]We've expanded our collection of tracks. Now your videos will resonate in a new way.
[*] [b]It’s now easier to upload your short videos directly to TikTok. [/b]
 Share your clips in seconds and collect those views and likes!
[*] [b]New trendy frames. [/b]
Draw attention to the most action-packed moments in your game
[*] [b]Fresh DLC effects sets. 
[/b]Choose from a vast collection of outros and intro videos, titles, stickers, transitions, and backgrounds to create engaging and thrilling Let’s Plays for social networks and video sharing platforms
[*] [b]The program name and icon have been changed slightly – from Video Editor Plus to Video Editor. [/b]
Your favorite program is still just as useful as it’s always been – you can be sure of that.
[/list]
